title: Submission, Deliverables & Handover

scope.purpose: Define the ISO 19650 information-model delivery sequence and TIVERIT supplementary submission, milestone and handover governance.

requirements.statement: Where ISO 19650-2 applies, formal information-model delivery shall follow the applicable sequence in 5.7: task-team submission for lead-appointed-party authorization, lead-appointed-party review and authorization, submission for appointing-party acceptance, and appointing-party review and acceptance.

The ISO 19650-2 delivery sequence shall remain distinct from TIVERIT coordination sign-off, internal milestone approval and handover acceptance. Supplementary TIVERIT decisions shall not replace or rename the ISO authorization and acceptance activities.

Before the 5.7 delivery sequence, information shall have completed the applicable collaborative-production activities, including task-team review and approval for sharing under ISO 19650-2 5.6.4 where applicable.

Submission for authorization shall identify the information model or containers submitted, applicable exchange/milestone context, purpose/status, relevant information requirements and supporting review evidence required by the governing project arrangements.
Lead-appointed-party authorization shall be recorded as the authorization activity in the ISO 19650-2 delivery sequence and shall not be represented as appointing-party acceptance.
Following authorization, submission for appointing-party acceptance shall remain a distinct delivery activity with traceable submitted scope and applicable acceptance criteria.
Appointing-party acceptance or rejection shall be recorded as the receiving-side acceptance outcome for the submitted information model in the applicable ISO 19650-2 delivery sequence.

For ISO 19650-governed CDE exchange, transition from Shared to Published shall be linked to completion of the applicable authorization and acceptance process; the Published state records the resulting information state but shall not replace the underlying review and decision evidence.

Transmission, transmittal, upload, publication action, platform permission, coordination sign-off, issue closure or workflow completion shall not substitute for the ISO 19650-2 authorization or acceptance activity.

Each formal exchange shall preserve traceability between the information issued, declared purpose/status and permitted use, applicable information requirements, review evidence, authorization outcome, acceptance outcome and CDE transition where applicable.

The governance meaning of the ISO 19650 delivery sequence shall be platform-independent; ACC, another CDE, or a file-transfer mechanism may implement the process but shall not alter the required decision sequence or assigned parties.

Project deliverable scope, information requirements, acceptance criteria, exchange dates, formats and status/permitted-use codes shall be taken from the applicable project information-management and appointment instruments rather than inferred from visual completeness or file type.

The receiving party shall not be expected to infer missing scope, purpose, responsibility, status/permitted use, authorization, acceptance or authority basis from visual appearance, file format, CDE location, institutional memory or undocumented assumptions.

Where project phase, appointment, scope, information requirements, acceptance criteria or responsible party changes, the affected exchange conditions shall be re-established through the applicable project governance before reliance continues.

TIVERIT milestone approval, where used, is a supplementary project decision and shall be explicitly defined by the governing project instrument; it shall not be treated as a synonym for ISO 19650-2 lead-appointed-party authorization or appointing-party acceptance.

Handover acceptance, where required, is a supplementary lifecycle/contractual decision governed by applicable information requirements, appointment, contract and project handover instruments; it shall not be inferred solely from prior ISO 19650 authorization/acceptance or from movement to Archived.

Handover deliverables shall include the project-governed record information, asset data, documentation and operations/maintenance information required by the applicable information requirements and handover instruments; no universal deliverable set shall be inferred solely from this enterprise standard.
Asset data delivered at handover shall conform to governed asset/lifecycle schemas where such schemas are applicable to the project.
All formal exchanges and handover submissions shall be registered and tracked in the governed exchange/transmittal record required by the applicable project arrangements.

A CDE state change, transmittal, publication action, workflow completion, technical permission or tool execution shall not create or expand the authority of the person or system performing that action; authority derives from the applicable ISO 19650 role/party assignment and governing project instruments.

implementation_gaps: TIVERIT role registry shall map project roles to ISO 19650 task team, lead appointed party and appointing party functions only where the appointment/BEP/RACI provides the required authority; no enterprise job title shall be assumed to hold an ISO party decision by default.
Conformance coverage shall verify the ISO 19650-2 5.7 sequence and detect substitution of coordination sign-off, milestone approval, platform status or tool execution for authorization or acceptance.
governance_notes: ISO 19650-2 5.7.1 through 5.7.4 is the canonical ISO delivery sequence for this standard where that part is applicable: submit for lead-appointed-party authorization; review and authorize; submit for appointing-party acceptance; review and accept.

ISO 19650-2 5.6.4 approval for sharing precedes the 5.7 delivery sequence. ISO 19650-4 Decision A and Decision B labels may be used in implementation/conformance mappings, but they do not replace the underlying ISO 19650-2 party/activity semantics.

TIVERIT coordination sign-off, milestone approval and handover acceptance are supplementary controls. They remain outside the canonical ISO 19650-2 5.7 sequence unless an applicable project instrument explicitly combines decisions without obscuring the ISO responsibilities.

Project deliverable lists, dates, exchange windows, formats, CDE paths, acceptance criteria and authority assignments remain project/BEP/appointment declarations except where an applicable enterprise rule legitimately governs them.

provenance.migration_note: ISO-IMP-005 re-audit makes ISO 19650-2 5.7.1-5.7.4 the canonical ISO information-model delivery sequence, retains 5.6.4 approval for sharing as its upstream prerequisite, and classifies TIVERIT coordination sign-off, milestone approval and handover acceptance as supplementary governance rather than ISO-equivalent decisions.
